svg.title: We fix the meaning of all activity estimates before using them. At a fixed finite torus Λn = (Z/nZ)4, let Cn = GΛn×{0,1,2,3} be the configuration space and An = gΛn×{0,1,2,3} its real space of left-link directions. A function is local on a site set X if its value depends only on links with both endpoints in X. Gauge invariance refers to Ux,i 7→kxUx,ik−1 x+ei.
